label: sub_008_master_01
text: Hey, I can put any Pokémon that’s Lv. 50 or\nhigher through Hyper Training, if you’d like!

label: sub_008_master_02
text: Whaddya say? Do you want one of your\nPokémon to go through Hyper Training?

label: sub_008_master_03
text: So, which Pokémon d’you want me to\nHyper Train?

label: sub_008_master_04
text: Huh? Sorry, kid, but it looks like you don’t have\nany Bottle Caps or Gold Bottle Caps.

label: sub_008_master_05
text: Your Pokémon can’t withstand Hyper Training\nunless they’ve reached Lv. 50.

label: sub_008_master_07
text: Do you want to use Bottle Caps or a Gold\nBottle Cap?

label: sub_008_master_08
text: So you want me to raise all of its stats?

label: sub_008_master_09
text: Which stat do you want me to raise?

label: sub_008_master_10
text: Hope you’re ready. Let’s get to Hyper Training!

label: sub_008_master_11
text: That stat is so high, it doesn’t need Hyper\nTraining.

label: sub_008_master_14
text: Do you want to continue Hyper Training?
